note: What the reflection factory says to its model and in its refusals (2026-09-29): the code fills the holes {name} and says nothing of its own.
intention: Read the patterns of the traces ({count}) and propose one adaptation of the conduct that answers them: a patch on one file the spec lets adapt, with why and the patterns it answers. It is adopted in a fork only, and measured there.

capabilities.propose: Propose the adaptation: the file (target), the patch (ops: each an op and a JSON Pointer, pointer; append adds a sentence at the end of an instruction; a segment [id=x] picks the element of a list by its id), why (reason), the ids of the patterns it answers (evidence), and the justification of each number the patch sets ([] when it sets none). It changes what a factory is told, never a procedure's numbers, and names a fact by its id, never its value. The guard applies it to a copy and checks the file is still what its reader needs; an accepted one is written to {file} for the station.

brief.plan: Stage 1 of 3, the plan. The patterns are in the state (hypothesis, field "patterns"), each with its id, what it says, how many times, and the file its fix would touch; the files are there whole (field "files"), with what may adapt and what never (fields "adaptable" and "never"). Declare with task.plan that the adaptation is written here: no node of the catalogue, the output {name} missing, to the topic "reflection".
brief.propose: Stage 2 of 3, the adaptation. Choose the pattern a change of conduct answers best. For a factory that keeps making a mistake, add to what it reads before it makes it (field "places": the brief of the stage that calls the capability, the tool's description) the rule it breaks, said by its words and the ids of the facts it names, never their values. Propose the smallest patch with reflection.propose: one file, the ops (append to add a sentence), the reason in a sentence, the ids of the patterns as evidence, and the justifications of the numbers it sets ([] when none).{refused}
brief.refused: Your last adaptation was refused: {problems}. Correct what it says and propose it again, whole.
brief.handOver: Stage 3 of 3, hand over. The guard accepted {path}. End with task.done, the adaptation as the artifact of kind "adaptation"; the station adopts it in the fork and says so.

guard.accepted: the adaptation {path} is already accepted: end with task.done

openQuestions.plan: the plan: the adaptation is written here (task.plan)
openQuestions.propose: the adaptation, applied to a copy and checked (reflection.propose)

validate.none: no adaptation among the claimed artifacts
validate.notAccepted: no adaptation was accepted by the guard in this task (reflection.propose)
validate.notTheFile: claimed adaptation "{path}" is not the file the guard accepted ({accepted})
